name: Ouroboros Serpent Tongue Relay
description: The Ouroboros Serpent Tongue Relay is a secure channel device built around a single conceptual innovation: it routes all transmissions through Ouroboros Energy's proprietary smart-grid infrastructure, embedding communications data within the load-balancing telemetry that the corporation's power distribution network broadcasts continuously across GLMZ. Because the city's power grid is the most heavily trafficked and least-scrutinized data channel in existence — monitored obsessively for energy metrics but almost never for embedded payloads — the Serpent Tongue achieves a form of steganographic invisibility that no dedicated communications channel can match. A transmission sent through a Serpent Tongue relay is, to any external observer, a routine fluctuation in district power consumption data.

specifications.transmission_method: Steganographic embedding in smart-grid load-balancing telemetry
specifications.wireless_emissions: None — fully air-gapped from RF spectrum
specifications.connection_requirements: Physical hardwire to live Ouroboros smart-grid connection point
specifications.range: Any location connected to the Ouroboros grid citywide
specifications.encryption: Ouroboros proprietary OES-Steg encoding; 8192-bit session keys
specifications.bandwidth: Low — text and compressed audio only; no video transmission
specifications.detectability: Undetectable by RF sweep; requires physical inspection of grid telemetry data or knowledge of OES-Steg encoding to identify
specifications.availability: Private client sales only through Ouroboros Client Relations division

tactical_use: The Serpent Tongue is used to establish a permanent secure channel between fixed locations — a safe house and a handler's office, two corporate black sites, a laundering front and its financial coordinator. Because it requires hardwired grid access, it is not a field communication tool; it is infrastructure. Operators use it to send operational orders, financial transfers, and intelligence packages through a channel that survives even aggressive electronic warfare environments, since suppressing smart-grid telemetry would require shutting down city power. The device's low bandwidth is a tactical constraint — complex data packages must be compressed or transmitted in segments over time.
cultural_context: Ownership of a Serpent Tongue relay is a statement of institutional seriousness. It is not a device for individuals — it is a device for organizations with fixed infrastructure and the kind of long-term operational horizon that warrants investment in permanent secure communication channels. In GLMZ's power landscape, the fact that the device runs through Ouroboros Energy's grid means that Ouroboros theoretically has access to all traffic — a fact that every sophisticated user understands and accepts as the cost of using the channel. This creates a peculiar dynamic: the Serpent Tongue is trusted precisely because the only entity capable of monitoring it is also the entity selling it, and Ouroboros's business model depends on that trust remaining intact.
known_users: Senior corporate executives maintaining off-record communication channels
Long-established criminal organizations with fixed safe house infrastructure
Political factions operating within GLMZ's governance structure
Ouroboros Energy's own internal black operations division
Certain high-tier fixers who have maintained the same safe house for years
story_hooks: The party discovers a Serpent Tongue relay hardwired into the basement of a building they've been using as a safe house — it was there before they arrived, and it's been transmitting.
Ouroboros Energy's client relations division keeps meticulous records of every Serpent Tongue sale; someone has stolen that list, and the buyers on it are beginning to be targeted.

A Serpent Tongue channel goes suddenly silent mid-transmission — not because the device was destroyed, but because Ouroboros shut down power to an entire district as leverage in a contract dispute, and the communication it was carrying was time-critical.

The party is offered a Serpent Tongue relay as payment for a job; the device's installation port still has fragments of the previous owner's grid connection point attached — cross-referencing the grid node address reveals a location that several powerful entities would very much like to find.
related_entities: Ouroboros Energy Power Distribution Trunk Network

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, deliberately inconspicuous box resembling industrial power management hardware. Rectangular slab with slightly beveled edges and a minimalist industrial aesthetic designed to blend into server rooms and utility closets. Top surface features a subtle company nameplate; the device prioritizes function over corporate flash.
physical_description.dimensions: 28cm wide × 18cm deep × 7cm tall — roughly the footprint of a large paperback book standing on edge
physical_description.weight_description: 1.4kg — easily handheld but substantial enough to feel engineered; requires mounting bracket for permanent installation
physical_description.primary_material: Brushed aluminum chassis with stainless steel reinforcement at connection points
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal-gray anodized aluminum with non-reflective surface treatment to minimize visual detection. Minimal texture, designed for institutional anonymity.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray as primary; accents in subdued corporate teal (Ouroboros Energy brand color) only on manufacturer nameplate and single status indicator LED
physical_description.interface_elements: Single status LED (teal, small); two physical ports on rear: one ruggedized Ouroboros grid-connector (proprietary hardwire jack, gold-plated contacts) and one secondary access port (sealed under warning labels). Minimal buttons — only a recessed reset. No displays, no screens, no visual feedback beyond the status light.
distinctive_features: Hardwire-only design creates visible distinction from wireless devices — cable permanence is its signature
Grid connector is oversized relative to body, clearly designed for single-purpose industrial integration
Top surface etched with faint warning text in multiple languages: 'AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY' and Ouroboros proprietary data handling notices
Thermal venting along rear edge suggests active cooling for continuous operation
Complete absence of branding beyond the Amp Audio Systems/Ouroboros Energy logotype — intentionally bland corporate aesthetic
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Amp Audio Systems logo (stylized wave form) embossed on top left; Ouroboros Energy corporate seal beneath; regulatory compliance stamps (FCC-equivalent GLMZ Authority approval) along bottom edge; unique serial number laser-etched on underside
physical_description.condition_typical: Mounted permanently to server rack or utility panel in secured facility, with cable bundle leading into conduit. Dust accumulation minimal due to controlled environment. Status LED glowing steady teal in darkened server room. Device essentially disappears into infrastructure — the goal of its design.
